create_masked_compositional_channel: create a MaskedCompositionalSeq2SeqFileChannel to log predictions with samplewise losses and topk tree predictions
build_masked_metric_reporter: build a MaskedSeq2SeqCompositionalMetricReporter from config to calculate masked compositional metrics for seq2seq models
calculate_masked_metrics: calculate masked metrics using compute_masked_metrics with frame prediction pairs and target lengths
create_nas_masked_reporter: create a NASMaskedSeq2SeqCompositionalMetricReporter to compute NAS-aware masked metrics with parameter importance weighting
aggregate_beam_predictions: aggregate beam search predictions into pred trees, non-invalid trees, and extracted subtree trees
